manifest.title: Authored bounded count fixture
manifest.statement: Read n integers and x; print the number of values at most x. n is 1 to 8, array values are 0 to 9, x is 0 to 10.

package.reference:
n=int(input())
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
x=int(input())
print(sum(1 for v in a if v<=x))

source:
n=int(input())
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
x=int(input())
a.sort()
l=0
r=n
while l<r:
    mid=(l+r)//2
    if a[mid]<=x:
        l=mid
    else:
        r=mid
print(l)
fixed_source:
n=int(input())
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
x=int(input())
a.sort()
l=0
r=n
while l<r:
    mid=(l+r)//2
    if a[mid]<=x:
        l=mid+1
    else:
        r=mid
print(l)
